UCaKdBA_InKwyTUqUPK5szDw.description:
Trafilatura is a cutting-edge Python and command-line tool designed to gather text on the Web and simplify the process of turning raw HTML into structured, meaningful data. It includes all necessary discovery and text processing components to perform web crawling, downloads, scraping, and extraction of main texts, metadata and comments. 

Smart navigation and going from HTML bulk to essential parts can alleviate many problems related to text quality, first by focusing on the right web pages, second by avoiding the noise caused by recurring elements (headers, footers, links/blogroll etc.), and third by including information such as author and date in order to make sense of the data. The extractor tries to strike a balance between limiting noise (precision) and including all valid parts (recall). It also has to be robust and reasonably fast, it runs in production on millions of documents.

Taipy is an open-source Python library for building front-end and back-end features.

On the one hand, it provides a simple and low-code syntax that helps accelerate the process of creating interactive multiple-page dashboards with Python (and augmented Markdown). This web application builder generates highly interactive interfaces without requiring any knowledge of web development.

And at the same time, the Taipy package is designed to build powerful and customized data-driven back-end applications. It provides intuitive components to organize and manage data through pipelines and data flow orchestration. 

Configuring your pipelines has never been simpler with the help of Taipy Studio, the graphical editor!

UCrijXvbQg67m9-le28c7rPA.description:
Quix Streams is an open source Python library for processing data in Apache Kafka. Designed around the principle of DataFrames (tabular representation of streaming data), it helps teams build real-time data pipelines for ML and analytics, by simplifying the transition from batch-based processing using libraries like Pandas to stream-based processing

Best in class Python developer experience with pure Python, no JVM, no wrappers around other languages, and no cross-language debugging. It allows developers to utilize the full Python ecosystem. It’s stateful, fault-tolerant and promotes best practices to quickly deploy and scale out for production.

To learn more you can
1. Follow/star the repo: https://github.com/quixio/quix-streams
2. Join the Slack community: https://quix.io/slack-invite
3. Visit: https://quix.io/

Browser Automation Studio (BAS) is a powerful, user-friendly tool designed for automating web browser tasks. It allows users to create scripts that can perform repetitive actions on websites without manual intervention. BAS is particularly popular for tasks like web scraping, data extraction, form filling, and automated testing.
1. No Coding Required: BAS provides a visual scripting interface, making it accessible to users without programming knowledge.
2. Multi-Browser Support: It supports various browsers like Chrome, Firefox, and others for automation.
3. Built-In Functions: Includes pre-built actions like clicking, typing, navigating, extracting data, and handling CAPTCHAs.
4. Proxy Support: Allows the use of proxies for IP rotation and anonymity.
5. JavaScript Integration: Advanced users can write custom JavaScript for more complex tasks.
6. Data Extraction: Easily extract and save data from websites into formats like CSV or Excel.

CLICK HERE to learn more about me and this channel!

Welcome - my name is Tom Wilhelm and I have been a professional pentester for over two decades. My latest career role was that of a pentesting Practice Director in charge of a large team of other professional penetration testers. I have written numerous books on the topic, spoken at Hacker Conferences across the US, and was an Associate Professor teaching ethical hacking to both undergrad and graduates. Before that, I was in the U.S. Army as a Signals Intelligence Analyst, Cryptanalyst, and Russian Linguist. I started learning about hacking in the 80's back when BBS systems were all the rage and dial up modems were the primary way to be connected with other hackers, so I've seen a lot and can share a lot.

I created this channel to expand my teaching of the ethics and techniques needed to become a professional penetration tester to a wider audience. Hope you enjoy, and good luck on your journey to be a professional, ethical hacker!
